newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Stg/mark sets sight on 2.7770-mark lows.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Stg/mark sets sight on 2.7770-mark lows.

text.p: Sterling mark, hovering near two-week lows, should drift further on Monday as it targets the 2.7770-mark level, said analysts.
"It (sterling/mark) is again under pressure. The 2.7770-mark target may come under pressure today," said Ian Park, a director at Capital Management.
At 0732 GMT sterling/mark was trading at 2.7805/15 marks against 2.7959/64 in late Europe on Friday, and just above session lows at 2.7799 marks.
Against the dollar, sterling was at $1.6338/48 from $1.6312/22.
Below the 2.7770-mark level there is a solid band of support between 2.7730 and 2.7690 marks, said Karen Jones, technical analyst at Credit Suisse First Boston.
She said the 2.7730-mark area is a reaction high, and the 2.7690 area is key because it represents a 61.8 percent retracement of sterling/mark's last leg higher.
"If the 2.7690 area, a key break point, does not hold we could see sterling/mark under pressure towards the 2.7300-2.7290 area," Jones added.
Resistance could cap any upside attempt around the 2.80 and 2.8050-mark levels, she added.

Analysts said cable, even though a touch firmer on Monday, was likely to be weighed down after its failure to follow through on the upside or hold near three-week peaks just above $1.6380. But a stumble would be cushioned around the $1.63 area and just below.
"It should bounce off the $1.6310 area...But if that doesn't hold it could head back to $1.6220 - a key support area," said CS First Boston's Jones.
A bounce from the $1.6310 area would drive cable back towards near three-week highs just above $1.6380 and further towards $1.6420/70, said analysts.
RSI - 14 day: Stg/mark: 54 pct, Stg/dollar: 55 pct
